title: Assassination of Anthony 'Tatu' Gounden
description: Alleged Tatu gang boss Anthony Gounden was ambushed and killed at a BP garage near Sibaya. The hit is believed to be linked to an earlier altercation at an Umhlanga sports bar.

title: Assassination of William 'Red' Stevens
description: William 'Red' Stevens, a high-ranking 27s general, was shot dead outside his home. His death sparked retaliatory shootings between the 27s and 28s.

title: Assassination of Ernie 'Lastig' Solomon
description: Ernie Solomon, leader of the Terrible Josters and a prominent 28s figure, was killed in a hit in Boksburg. The murder is linked to internal power struggles and a major drugs shipment dispute.

title: Assassination of Kalvin Periasamy
location: Gateway Shopping Mall Parking, uMhlanga, KZN
description: Prominent Phoenix gang leader Kalvin Periasamy was executed in the Gateway Mall parking lot. He was allegedly the head of the 'Bloods' drug cartel.

title: Assassination of Rashied Staggie
description: Legendary Hard Livings leader Rashied Staggie was shot dead in a drive-by outside his home in Salt River, echoing his brother Rashaad's death in 1996.

title: Assassination of Igsaan 'Sanie American' Davids
description: Igsaan Davids, allegedly the leader of the Americans gang, died in hospital three weeks after being shot in Kensington.

title: Execution of Yusuf 'U-Boy' Bohardien
location: Tennyson Street, Salt River, Cape Town
description: Former NTK member Yusuf Bohardien was executed by attackers who shot him in the back and then 'finished the job' with shots to the face. Linked to Junior Mafias' expansion.

title: Athlone Triple Murder (Infant Victim)
description: A nine-month-old baby and two women were gunned down in a shooting at a known drug den in Bridgetown, Athlone.

title: Saulsville Hostel Massacre
description: 12 people were killed and 13 injured when gunmen stormed a hostel tavern. Linked to rivalries between splinter groups of an extortion gang.

title: Assassination of Sadia Madatt
description: The daughter of former Americans boss 'Dimes' Madatt was killed in a mass shooting in Viscount Street. She was reportedly climbing the gang ranks.

title: Assassination of Andre Naude
description: Underworld figure Andre Naude, a co-accused in the Brian Wainstein murder case, was gunned down in Parow.

title: Rocklands Mass Shooting (December 2025)
description: A 9-year-old boy and two family members were gunned down when gunmen stormed a house in Viscount Street. Linked to drug turf conflicts.

title: Delft Zandkloof Street Mass Shooting
description: Four males, including a teenager, were executed in a granny flat. All sustained gunshot wounds to the head.

title: Montrose Park Double Murder
location: Veronica Road, Montrose Park, Mitchells Plain
description: Two teenagers were followed from a local tuckshop and gunned down at close range in a drive-by shooting.

title: Nyanga Terminus Taxi Rank Shooting
location: Nyanga Terminus Taxi Rank, Cape Town
description: Unknown gunmen opened fire on a minibus taxi carrying CATA members to a meeting, killing two women.
